summary_en: Nishi-Nippon Financial Holdings authorized acquisition of up to 1.5 million shares (1.08% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 5.0 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 11 to December 31, 2026, as part of its discretionary shareholder return policy targeting a dividend payout ratio of approximately 40%.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 10, 2026, Nishi-Nippon Financial Holdings' Board of Directors authorized the acquisition of up to 1.5 million shares of common stock, representing 1.08% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock, for a maximum of 5.0 billion yen. The shares will be purchased through ordinary market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from November 11 to December 31, 2026.

The company operates under a shareholder return policy that targets a dividend payout ratio of approximately 40% of consolidated net income attributable to parent company shareholders, supplemented by discretionary treasury stock acquisitions based on earnings outlook and other business conditions. Management stated that this acquisition aims to enhance returns to shareholders and improve capital efficiency in line with this policy.
